basics.name: Muhammad Shuja
basics.label: Digital and Performance Marketer
basics.summary: Digital and performance marketer with 5 years across paid search, paid social, SEO, e-commerce growth and lifecycle marketing, spanning agency work for B2B and B2C clients (including direct-to-consumer e-commerce) and in-house healthcare marketing. Managed about $272K in combined monthly client ad spend across 20-25 concurrent paid accounts; built an agency's first paid media capability from zero; now runs marketing operations and AI automation for a 3-location retail group. Engineer's training (B.Eng. Software Engineering), analyst's toolkit (M.S. MIS), marketer's track record.

work.name: Wellborn Ascent
work.summary: Multi-unit retail group, 3 locations, 14 staff; reporting directly to ownership.
highlights: Launched Meta and Google advertising from scratch across 3 locations, about $20K a month in actual spend; at unchanged $12,000 Meta spend, cost per recorded outcome fell from $28.57 to $20.00 (Aug to Sep 2026)
Built an AI-enabled operations platform (Claude API, Zapier/Make, Node.js, SQL, Slack interface) for 3 sites and 14 users, enabling about $105K in annualized wage reductions
Claude-assisted reconciliation across 6 bank accounts cleared a 9-month backlog in 1 week; flagged entries verified by hand
Cut daily reporting from 2 hours per site to 15 minutes across all 3, and multi-location KPI tracking from about 6 hours a day to 45 minutes
Analyze 60K+ monthly POS sales transactions in SQL to inform purchasing, pricing and site-level decisions; sales-based replenishment for about 150 items per store
Relaunched an in-house food brand, lifting daily revenue 87% (about $800 to $1,500); cut Store 1 discarded food from about $100 to $10 a day at retail value
Raised brand compliance audit scores from 60-65% to 99% across 3 locations

work.name: PrimaCare Home Healthcare (Dubai)
work.summary: Sole marketer for an at-home healthcare booking platform.
highlights: Sole owner of the marketing function; managed about $15K a month in Google and Meta spend
Grew online appointments 300% over 2022 through Meta, Google and retargeting
Cut paid-media CAC from $105 to $75 at the same monthly spend (Feb-Mar vs Oct-Nov 2022), with CRM-verified, deduplicated customer attribution
Randomized booking-form A/B test raised inquiry conversion from 6.0% to 9.0% (2,000 visitors per arm)
37% increase in repeat paid-booking frequency per eligible existing customer (1.50 to 2.055)
Geo-targeted campaigns across 200+ localities; built an internal WordPress booking and billing CRM cutting appointment scheduling time 75%
Developed brand identity and produced print, web, and social content in-house

work.name: Brandwise Media & Marketing (Dubai)
work.summary: Built the agency's first paid media capability and digital division from zero; 25-30-client portfolio.
highlights: Managed about $272K in combined monthly client ad spend (peaks near $320K) across 20-25 concurrent paid accounts, execution shared with the team
Hired 2 marketers into the division and mentored 3 junior marketers; trained business development to pitch and price paid media
Shipped 12 WordPress websites across e-commerce, travel and hospitality, F&B, retail, B2B corporate and edtech
Food Crowd (e-commerce grocery): 18.6x ROAS, $2.66 per attributed order, $49.52 AOV (Aug-Sep 2021); orders +67%, revenue +42% vs May-Jun
J5 Hotels: Meta link CTR 1.1% to 4.3% with room-specific creative and video
Robostores: lead-to-meeting rate 25% to 30.5% (+22% relative) at unchanged spend

Al Aaraf Jewelers (2019-20, sole marketer): built the first Magento store; digitally originated revenue +134%; eight keywords on Google page one in 6 months; off-peak showroom visits +39% year over year

work.name: Alcium Software (Sheffield, UK)
highlights: Integrated MS Graph API features in C# for CRM serving real estate and government clients
Rebuilt search algorithm; produced SDLC/Agile documentation
